params.description: Required. Full resource name of [Product][google.cloud.retail.v2.Product], such as projects/*/locations/global/catalogs/default_catalog/branches/default_branch/products/some_product_id. If the caller does not have permission to delete the [Product][google.cloud.retail.v2.Product], regardless of whether or not it exists, a PERMISSION_DENIED error is returned. If the [Product][google.cloud.retail.v2.Product] to delete does not exist, a NOT_FOUND error is returned.
